detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to The Cozy Board Game Shop, a warm, sunlit store packed with board games... and every single box is on the floor. A Shop Full of Stories Arthur ran this shop for thirty years. Now it's yours. Last night his grandson Theo wanted to play with every game, just once, while Arthur fell asleep in the armchair. Theo didn't. Put every game back where it belongs and the shop is ready to open its doors again. Tidy, Shelve, Relax Pick up copies, carry them in a wobbly stack and find their home on the right shelf. Fill a section with all twelve copies of a game and watch it light up in a cascade of little boxes. Bit by bit, the chaos turns into a perfectly organised shop. Helpful Skills Every game you shelve earns XP, and XP earns skill points. Spend them on skills that make tidying even more satisfying: Copy Sense reveals every loose copy of the game in your hands, Magnet Hands pulls nearby copies straight to you, Quick Stack fills a shelf in one go and Smart Stack sorts your stack as you look at the shelves. Features 3,816 boxes to tidy : 318 board games, twelve copies each, every one with its own parody cover. Can you spot the games you know? 15 categories on two floors , from Kids and Party & Words to Fantasy & Dungeons, Sci-Fi & Space and Mystery & Spies. A shop full of nooks : a sunny greenhouse, a candle-lit horror room, a detective's office and a reading loft. Carry a whole stack at once , cycle through it with the mouse wheel, or toss a box across the room. 7 skills to unlock , 4 active and 3 passive, from faster running to carrying more games at once. Lost? Check the shop map on the lectern by the stairs. A relaxing soundtrack and soft, satisfying sounds. Fully localized in 12 languages , including a voiced welcome letter in every language. No timers, no pressure. Tidy at your own pace and save whenever you like. Streamers & creators Streaming, Let's Plays and monetized videos are welcome, no permission needed. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to The Cozy Board Game Shop, a warm, sunlit store packed with board games... and every single box is on the floor.

A Shop Full of Stories

Arthur ran this shop for thirty years. Now it's yours. Last night his grandson Theo wanted to play with every game, just once, while Arthur fell asleep in the armchair. Theo didn't. Put every game back where it belongs and the shop is ready to open its doors again.

Tidy, Shelve, Relax

Pick up copies, carry them in a wobbly stack and find their home on the right shelf. Fill a section with all twelve copies of a game and watch it light up in a cascade of little boxes. Bit by bit, the chaos turns into a perfectly organised shop.

Helpful Skills

Every game you shelve earns XP, and XP earns skill points. Spend them on skills that make tidying even more satisfying: Copy Sense reveals every loose copy of the game in your hands, Magnet Hands pulls nearby copies straight to you, Quick Stack fills a shelf in one go and Smart Stack sorts your stack as you look at the shelves.

Features

  • 3,816 boxes to tidy: 318 board games, twelve copies each, every one with its own parody cover. Can you spot the games you know?

  • 15 categories on two floors, from Kids and Party & Words to Fantasy & Dungeons, Sci-Fi & Space and Mystery & Spies.

  • A shop full of nooks: a sunny greenhouse, a candle-lit horror room, a detective's office and a reading loft.

  • Carry a whole stack at once, cycle through it with the mouse wheel, or toss a box across the room.

  • 7 skills to unlock, 4 active and 3 passive, from faster running to carrying more games at once.

  • Lost? Check the shop map on the lectern by the stairs.

  • A relaxing soundtrack and soft, satisfying sounds.

  • Fully localized in 12 languages, including a voiced welcome letter in every language.

  • No timers, no pressure. Tidy at your own pace and save whenever you like.

Streamers & creators

Streaming, Let's Plays and monetized videos are welcome, no permission needed. The soundtrack is not registered with Content ID, so it is safe to stream.
